title: decide(lane): one lane manifest and one task writer replace six guessed state stores
body:
Evidence: cross-model audit 2026-11-20 churn table: src/ci/ship.ts 41, src/hook/stop.ts 34, src/cli/lane.ts 31, src/cli/lane-run.ts 23 fix( touches in 14 days; defects D3, D4, D7, D8 share one class: every verb and hook guesses lane and task state from six stores (.krn/task-claims/, .krn/runs/shipped/, .krn/tmp/ship.pid, .krn/tmp/*.parked, refs/krn/pending-tasks, transcript and cwd scraping in stop.ts and scope.ts).
Decision needed (lead, ADR first): one transactional lane manifest (laneId, worktree, branch, task, phase, shipSha, shipHead, shipPid) passed to hooks by KRN_LANE_ID, one writeTaskRecord() owning pending-ref vs worktree storage, and one real-git lifecycle test (create, edit, dep, start, scope, stop, ship, drop) with no stubbed transport or prior-lane state.
Outcome: an ADR records the store design; the lifecycle suite runs in CI; hooks read the manifest instead of transcripts.
Proof: fix commits on the changed set fall at least 40% from 129 within two 14-day windows after migration (ADR 0029 Consequences gives the git log command).
